lines: His snaps dropped to 29% over his last 3 games, down from 54% for the season, and he has played 7 of 10 games.
He saw 3.7 targets per game over that stretch, a 12% target share, and averaged 6.0 PPR points and 20.0 receiving yards per game.
The coach said Harrison is returning to practice but set no expectations for his role; we project 4.2 PPR in Week 12 against BAL.
